name: USPTO Trademark APIs
tagline: Official USPTO APIs for trademark status, assignments, and bulk trademark data.
description: Public USPTO developer APIs covering Trademark Status and Document Retrieval (TSDR), trademark assignment records, and bulk trademark data products for monitoring registration status, ownership changes, and large-scale trademark research.

auth.details: API key via request header after self-serve signup on developer.uspto.gov (confirm exact header name from current docs).

pricing.free_tier_limits: 60 requests/API key/minute; PDF/ZIP and multi-case PDF/ZIP: 4/key/minute. From 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. ET: 120 and 12/key/minute, respectively.

rate_limits: 60 requests/API key/minute; PDF/ZIP and multi-case PDF/ZIP: 4/key/minute. Off-peak (10 p.m.–5 a.m. ET): 120 and 12/key/minute, respectively. Limits may change with system availability and usage.
use_cases: check trademark registration status by serial number
download bulk trademark data for analysis
